0_AllyCraft_g1.Game narrative: AllyCraft is a tactical RPG where you control an archer character (@) navigating through a dangerous grid-based world filled with various enemy types including witches, goblin captains, demons, berserkers, and archers. The core gameplay revolves around strategic ally management - you can summon up to 3 allied archers (S) to fight alongside you, move them tactically around the battlefield, and coordinate attacks against enemies. The world contains valuable resources like ruby gems, crates, and barrels that can be activated and combined for strategic advantages, as well as treasure chests scattered across the map. Each enemy type has distinct AI behaviors: archers maintain distance and shoot from range, berserkers charge aggressively, demons use smart tactics, while others pursue you directly. You must carefully manage your health and that of your allies, utilizing healing abilities and defensive stances while fighting through increasingly dangerous encounters to reach your objective.
0_AllyCraft_g1.Win condition: The game is won by successfully reaching any interactive object tile (treasure chests marked as O, I, or C on the map) while your player character is still alive. The game ends in defeat if your player's health drops to 0 or below, or if you become surrounded by 3 or more adjacent enemies simultaneously.

EcoSync_g2.Game narrative: EcoSync is an environmental restoration adventure where the player takes on the role of an eco-warrior navigating a polluted 2D grid world filled with dangerous enemies (witches, goblin captains, and berserkers), contaminated areas, and precious resources. The player must strategically balance combat, environmental restoration, and resource management while maintaining their health, which deteriorates on polluted tiles but regenerates on cleansed areas. Using a diverse set of abilities including resource rallying, environmental cleansing to convert polluted tiles (M) into restored areas (G), tactical combat through ambush attacks, and a unique enemy teleportation power, the player works to restore the ecosystem while surviving in a hostile environment with multiple paths to victory.
EcoSync_g2.Win condition: Multiple victory paths: (1) Teleport Master - successfully teleport enemies 3+ times, (2) Perfect Victory - defeat all enemies, cleanse all pollution, collect most resources (≤3 remaining), (3) Environmental Victory - cleanse 8+ tiles with ≤1 enemy and ≤2 polluted tiles, (4) Combat Victory - defeat all enemies with 4+ cleansed tiles and ≤5 resources remaining, or (5) Resource Victory - collect most resources (≤2 remaining) with ≤3 polluted tiles and ≤1 enemy. The game ends in failure if player health reaches 0, environmental disaster occurs (6+ polluted tiles with ≤2 cleansed after 200 steps), or the 500-step time limit expires.

Elemental_Synergy_Quest_g3.Game narrative: Elemental Synergy Quest is a grid-based cooperative adventure where the player (@) navigates through a mystical world filled with elemental tiles (Fire/Flame-F, Water-W, Explosive/Earth-E), resource deposits (R), mysterious tiles (D), interactive chests (O), items (I), enemies (witches-#), NPCs (goblin captains-&), and magical clones (C). The core gameplay revolves around synergistic mechanics where the player can form elemental links with adjacent elemental tiles for bonus rewards, perform collaborative tile enrichment to strategically collect resources in wider areas, trigger cooperative burst explosions with explosive tiles, gain teleport synergy bonuses when near teleportation tiles (T), and collaborate with clones for additional benefits. The game emphasizes cooperative and elemental interactions, rewarding players for positioning themselves strategically near special tiles and other characters to maximize synergistic effects and efficiently collect resources.
Elemental_Synergy_Quest_g3.Win condition:
The game is won when the player collects 3 or more items by interacting with chests (O) and item tiles (I).
Alternatively, victory is achieved when all collectible tiles (F, W, E, R, D, T, O, I) are cleared from the map.
Items are added to inventory through direct interaction, incrementing the collected_items counter toward the target of 3.

Tile_Strategy_Quest_g4.Game narrative: Tile Strategy Quest is a tactical dungeon exploration game where players control an archer navigating a grid-based world filled with enemies, treasures, and magical opportunities. The player manages health (60 max) and mana (30 max) while collecting resource tiles and performing alchemical combinations - basic exchanges like X + Y → Z, or advanced mana-powered abilities including creating combination fields (C tiles) for magical enhancement, resource shields (S tiles) for protection, and strategic area blasts to clear enemies. Combat requires tactical health management and sometimes rare tiles to defeat stronger foes like witches and goblin captains, while exploration rewards players with resources from treasure chests and interactive objects. The core gameplay loop combines strategic movement, resource collection, tile crafting, and combat encounters, building toward increasingly powerful combinations and magical mastery through skillful positioning and mana management.
Tile_Strategy_Quest_g4.Win condition: Players can achieve victory through multiple diverse paths: Instant wins by crafting the ultimate LEGENDARY tile or looting 3+ treasure chests (Treasure Hunter); skill-based victories like Chain Master (4+ consecutive combinations), Combat Legend (defeat 3+ enemies with 70%+ health), or Mana Wizard (maintain 80%+ mana with combination tiles present); or epic achievements such as Domination (create 8+ tiles and defeat 4+ enemies), Phoenix Rising (recover from ≤25% to 80%+ health), or Perfect Harmony (balanced mastery: 60%+ health, 50%+ mana, possess Z tile, defeat 1+ enemy, achieve 2+ consecutive combinations). The game ends immediately when any single win condition is met, encouraging multiple playstyles from speed running to exploration to combat mastery.
